response.text:
Sandbox <id>
Owner: alice; started with: Observer on laptop.
Isolation: Shielded (a hardened container on the host's kernel); runs on runc; image sandhold/sandbox:dev.
Network: limited to pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, github.com.
Started: <time>, cold in <span>; it runs there because the template py-tests asks for shielded isolation; lifetime 10 min.

Commands: 2, 0 with a non-zero exit status.
  <time>  alice (an API key)  exit 0
  <time>  alice (an API key)  exit 0
  (The node records a command's exit status, not the command line.)

Network refusals: not known: its egress log is not kept once the sandbox has ended, so its network refusals cannot be read now.
Files written through the API: none.
  (Files a command writes inside the sandbox are not recorded.)
Changes:
  <time>  alice  Lifetime changed: 20 min from then

Ended: <time>, removed by alice.
